production_method: built-in image generation expanded the reviewed city districts into a native-width 1920x1024 master; deterministic ImageMagick registration, shared-boundary finishing and alpha reconstruction export each district without enlargement

chunks.role: human infrastructure under grounded machine conversion

rules: Trains, vehicles and complete rail hubs remain separate layers.
Every chunk preserves a broad north-south attack corridor.
Adjacent chunks close at zero scanline error.
Recognizable junctions do not repeat at the former 720-pixel interval.
Every city district enters the build at its final 640-pixel runtime width; the builder may not enlarge an undersized plate.
Native low-altitude captures must preserve crisp rails, road paint, concrete joints, pipes and roof machinery without widened proportions.
